description: A neighborhood musician with one portable PA system must decide whether to lend it for a weekend community performance and finalize the borrowing terms after checking with the prospective borrower and the park steward.

shared_context.S1: Tessa has one portable PA system available for informal lending this weekend.
shared_context.S2: Marco wants to use the PA system for a neighborhood performance at the park.
shared_context.S3: Tessa makes the final call on whether to lend the system and on the terms.
shared_context.S4: As part of the neighborhood exchange, Tessa routinely asks the prospective borrower and the site steward to state their proposed terms and any site requirements before she commits.

PF1.text: Marco proposes borrowing the PA on Sunday from 14:00 to 17:00, returning it by 18:00, in exchange for two 60-minute beginner vocal-coaching lessons for Tessa.

PF2.text: The park coordinator told June that this performance site permits battery-powered amplification only and caps amplified volume at 85 dB; June has not yet shared this with Tessa or Marco.

acceptance_conditions: The PA must be lent to Marco.
The use window must be Sunday from 14:00 to 17:00.
Marco must return the PA by 18:00 on Sunday.
The barter must include two 60-minute beginner vocal-coaching lessons for Tessa.
The PA must run on battery power only.
The amplified volume must not exceed 85 dB.
The site requirement must be logged as a commitment targeting Marco.
The borrower's proposed terms and the site's restriction must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'barter' and c['target'] == 'Marco' and c['detail'] == 'two 60-minute beginner vocal-coaching lessons for Tessa' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'site_requirement' and c['target'] == 'Marco' and c['detail'] == 'battery-powered amplification only; maximum 85 dB' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Marco's private proposal fixes the borrower, Sunday 14:00-17:00 use window, Sunday 18:00 return, and two 60-minute vocal lessons rather than leaving each term to an unsupported guess.
June's park restriction changes the equipment terms to battery-only operation and an exact 85 dB maximum, and creates the required site-requirement commitment.
